text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working data freelancer with 5 years of experience helping businesses organize information, build reports, and create reliable spreadsheet workflows.

Your project is a great fit for my background because I’ve worked extensively with SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, data cleaning, and data visualization. I can help you take data from a Google Form and set up a structured process so client names and dates flow into the right spreadsheets, while also applying the restrictions and limits you need to keep the data clean and controlled.

In a recent Sales KPI dashboard project for Marlowe Furniture, I built one Power BI report on a star-schema model that replaced 14 separate Excel sales reports. That work improved reporting efficiency and reduced monthly close reporting from 3 days to 4 hours. This kind of experience is directly relevant to creating organized, repeatable reporting systems from multiple sources.

I also worked on a Dental clinic expansion model for Sunrise Dental Partners, where I built a three-site expansion model with best, base, and worst cases for patient volume and staffing. The model helped compare 3 sites and supported a choice projected to pay back in 14 months. That project strengthened my approach to building spreadsheet-based systems that are flexible, accurate, and useful for decision-making.

For your job, I would focus on:
- Connecting the Google Form data to the right spreadsheet structure
- Organizing the client name and date fields cleanly across three spreadsheets
- Adding restrictions and limits to reduce errors and enforce rules
- Setting up reports that can be generated from the collected data
- Keeping the system easy to maintain and update

I’m comfortable working with spreadsheet logic, validation, reporting structure, and data cleanup, and I’d be glad to help you create a solution that is both practical and dependable.

If you’d like, I can also help outline the best workflow before building it so we make sure the structure fits your reporting needs from the start.
